That said, there were a few areas where our experience could have been better. When it came to flights, we often had to follow up and explore options ourselves, as the suggestions provided were quite limited. Unfortunately, our flights were impacted due to the Middle East situation, and for alternatives, we ended up managing bookings on our own as we couldn’t find suitable budget-friendly options through the team.

Similarly, for local car bookings, the options shared with us were on the higher side, so we chose not to go ahead with them. Once we reached, we realized there were several more affordable options available locally.

The tour was amazing. Siddhi did an excellent job as the tour guide. With his vast knowledge about the caves and Buddhism in general he was constantly providing us interesting information.
Besides the caves and the amazing amount of background knowledge, we saw monkeys in and deers in the park from very close and we could try fruits from the inhabitants of the park which we have never seen before (the palm fruit).
I will definitely recommend Siddhi as a tourgauide and the tour itself!

His vast knowledge and enthusiasm for the caves and Buddhism are truly assets to our team. We're glad you enjoyed the tour's unique experiences, from spotting wildlife to trying local fruits. Thank you for your recommendation, and we hope to serve you again soon!"

featured_reviews.name: Nachman Dahan
featured_reviews.review_text:
Rahul and his team are simply amazing. We had the most authentic two days in Mumbai, creating memories we will never forget. The highlight of our trip was the the Dharavi slum tour. Experiencing first hand the challenges of life in the slums, to the incredible entrepreneurial spirit of its people. From plastic recycling plants to bakeries ,clothing and leather operations. Meeting Rahuls family and their tremendous generosity was eye opening.
Rahul and his team have a School program in their office for under privilege kids. We got to meet the kids and talk to them about their dreams and aspirations. Knowing that the proceeds of our tour were going to better the life of the people living in the slums made this tour so much better. If you are in Mumbai the young traveles tours is something you shouldn't miss. We will be back!

featured_reviews.name: Haley Willis
featured_reviews.review_text: We had an incredible tour of Dharavi with Kamlesh. I really appreciated his connection to Dharavi and the care he took during the tour, given we were walking through a space where people work and live. We learned so much, and he was able to answer all of our many questions. I’d highly recommend this tour to anyone!
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you for your kind review! We’re glad you had a great experience exploring Dharavi with Kamlesh. His connection to the community and respectful approach mean a lot to us. We truly appreciate your recommendation and hope to welcome you again in Mumbai 😊🙏

featured_reviews.name: Karen Su
featured_reviews.review_text:
I joined the Lonavala - Hill Station tour a few days ago. Lonavala is a beautiful town. It took about 2 ~ 2.5 hours to get there and is totally worthwhile. Mr. Hardik was very knowledgeable and professional. The
caves are indeed very special in its own way especially the sculptures on the pillars. The surrounding areas are serene and beautiful. The tour ends at Lion point with spectacular views. It is a trip i’ll never forget.
